messages:
alex: Heads-up — NordEast Logistics flagged 24 H100s at FRA customs due to pallet weight mismatch. Landed ETA was 2024-07-08 09:00 CET, now on hold. AWB 219-NE-7741. :grimacing:

maria: These were for pool-bridge-2 topup to eu-west-1 burst, right?

alex: Yes. If clearance slips we miss q3 provisioning window.

liam: Any photos or manifests? customs often asks for weight cert or invoice reclass.

alex: Vendor sent carrier note but no pallet pics. They say customs requests HS code clarification + weight certificate + thermal packaging evidence.

vendor-bot: Vendor update: "FRA customs requested HS code clarification and weight cert. Processing 24-72h. Requesting insurer pre-approval for air-expedite."

sophie: If >24h, trigger contingency: crossdock from AMS spare pool or air-expedite partial shipment. Who's on the priority list?

alex: 8 units are high-priority for a latency-critical customer rollout; 16 are buffer.

maria: For the 8, can we borrow EU refurb pool or swap from partner? What's cost vs air-expedite?

liam: Air-expedite FRA->AMS ~€8k/unit all-in. Crossdock truck from next-day AMS pool ~€1.2k/unit but adds 18-24h.

sophie: 18-24h misses SLO. Recommend authorize air-expedite for 8 units. Need finance for ~€64k.

maria: Vendor offered 50% brokerage credit if customs error proven. Can we get proof?

alex: They're claiming paperwork mismatch and offered to expedite docs.

vendor-bot: Vendor uploaded updated commercial invoice + preliminary weight cert (signed). Customs still reviewing.

liam: Ops, open an RMA split so 8 units can be released for expedite and 16 remain on hold. Need separate AWBs/manifests.

ops-bot: Created RMA-SPLIT ticket RMA-2024-118. Workflow: split manifest, new AWB for expedite, insurer pre-approve. Assigned to @maria and @alex.

maria: I'll coordinate vendor paperwork and insurance. Alex, confirm customer ok with expedite cost.

alex: PM approved expedite if <6h in-region setup, but capped cost at €10k/unit.

liam: With vendor covering 50% brokerage, net uplift ~€4k/unit. Still above PM cap. Suggest company covers €2.5k/unit, vendor €1.5k/unit. Finance signoff required.

maria: Pinging finance and legal. Also request depot photos on receipt for TAT logs.

vendor-bot: Vendor confirms 50% brokerage cover and will push paperwork to speed customs.

sophie: If redirecting to AMS, pre-stage images and kv-cache warmup to avoid boot-time delays. Tag units for canary rollout to dedicated pool.

ops-bot: Pre-staging images on AMS rapid-provision pool. ETA 3h after AWB handoff.

maria: Finance provisionally approved up to €25k company cost-share for this incident pending reconciliation.

liam: Manifest split example for carrier API:

```
POST /v1/shipments/split
{ "original_awb": "219-NE-7741", "split_counts": [8,16], "destinations": ["AMS_DEPOT","FRA_HOLD"] }
```

maria: Alex, vendor just sent new AWB for 8: 219-NE-7741-A. Sharing now.

vendor-bot: AWB 219-NE-7741-A created and marked "expedite-requested". Courier: AeroSwift.

sophie: Label expedited units "q3-priority-expedite" and apply a canary rollout to reduce risk.

maria: Filing PM to update vendor contract: require pallet photos + HS-code checklist pre-shipment.

alex: Will update when customs clears or if vendor disputes cost share. :thumbsup:

vendor-bot: Final vendor update at 1744320045: FRA customs cleared 8 units at 13:12 CET after invoice reclass. Units released for pickup. Remaining 16 still pending."
